Name: Custom Dog Skin - Odie
Author: deadduch
Description:
Edit: This mod is old, and I never intend to update it to the new content. If anyone wants to take this and update it for themselves/others, permission granted.

A custom dog skin based on the IRL pet of a friend. He looks pretty cool in game, but don't let him fool you, he has a derpy face IRL.

Find the thread of my to do list and requests on this thread: [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-pet-skins-beroins-mod.109346/]http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/new-pet-skins-beroins-mod.109346/
[/url]
Mod Compatibilities

Using the Cursors.xnb in this mod will overwrite any other mod that has made changes to that image. 

There is an optional file called the Odie Animal Crossing Digspot that makes the Animal Crossing Digspot mod compatible with the Odie skin.  Installation instructions inside.[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/57/?]
[/url]
Animal Crossing Digspot mod by Lechet can be found here:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18?]http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18?[/url]
